summary.en: The 9th batch raised ₹3.1 lakh towards a long-held cultural project proposed by a much-loved teacher.
summary.kn: ಅಚ್ಚುಮೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರೊಬ್ಬರ ದೀರ್ಘಕಾಲದ ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ಯೋಜನೆಗೆ 9ನೇ ಬ್ಯಾಚ್ ₹3.1 ಲಕ್ಷ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿತು.

body:
The 9th batch alumni successfully raised ₹3.1 lakhs to support Benny Sir's dream of establishing a Cultural Park. This initiative demonstrates the strong bond between alumni and their beloved teachers.
